'''Víctor Hugo Moreira Teixeira''' (born 5 October 1982) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[FC Andorra]], as a [[midfielder]].

==Career==
Moreira has played club football for [[FC Rànger's]], [[UE Sant Julià]] and [[FC Lusitanos]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=27569|accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{soccerway|victor-moreira-teixeira/76246|accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2008.<ref name = "NFT"/>
